bets.why: Only two games start before 6 PM ET (SEA@CAR 1 PM, WPG@CHI 3:30 PM), so this is a small 2-leg SOG parlay at Novig, the lowest-hold book. Both legs are shots-on-goal overs priced 44-47% with fair at or above the price. NHL is the sport where our model competes with the market. Small stake, no claimed edge over 15%.
